artworks.title: Philoctetes on Lemnos
artworks.description: Lethière's exiled archer on Lemnos — the bow of Heracles at his side until Odysseus and Diomedes came to fetch him for the last act of the war.

artworks.title: The Procession of the Trojan Horse
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Trojans drag the horse through the gate — the end of the Little Iliad and the threshold of the Sack, with PALADI VOTUM inscribed on the offering Sinon swore was pious.

artworks.title: Odysseus and Diomedes Steal the Palladium
artworks.description: Bellucci paints the night theft — Helen's help in Apollodorus' version, the talisman without which Troy could not fall.
